stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The solid line separates two same-sized panels; support either orientation.
    col = next((c for c in range(w) if len(set(grid[r][c] for r in range(h))) == 1), None)
    if col is not None:
        a = [row[:col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[col + 1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        row = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
        a = grid[:row]
        b = grid[row + 1:]
    ah, aw = len(a), len(a[0])
    bh, bw = len(b), len(b[0])
    hh, ww = min(ah, bh), min(aw, bw)
    bg_a = Counter(x for line in a for x in line).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg_b = Counter(x for line in b for x in line).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg_a = Counter(x for line in a for x in line if x != bg_a).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[fg_a for _ in range(ww)] for _ in range(hh)]
    for r in range(hh):
        for c in range(ww):
            if a[r][c] == b[r][c]:
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out

{

 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider_col = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if divider_col is not None:
        a = [row[:divider_col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[divider_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        hh, ww = h, min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
    else:
        divider_row = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
        a, b = grid[:divider_row], grid[divider_row + 1:]
        hh, ww = min(len(a), len(b)), min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
    bg_a = Counter(v for row in a for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg_b = Counter(v for row in b for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg_a = Counter(v for row in a for v in row if v != bg_a).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg_b = Counter(v for row in b for v in row if v != bg_b).most_common(1)[0][0]
    if bg_a == bg_b:
        out = [[bg_a if a[r][c] != bg_a or b[r][c] != bg_b else 3 for c in range(ww)] for r in range(hh)]
    elif fg_a == fg_b:
        out = [[3 if a[r][c] == fg_a and b[r][c] == fg_b else fg_a for c in range(ww)] for r in range(hh)]
    else:
        out = [[3 if a[r][c] == fg_a else bg_b for c in range(ww)] for r in range(hh)]
    return out
"
